items.title: Experience the magic of Kosovo from anywhere with Street View
items.summary: From unique modern architecture to a UNESCO World Heritage site, Kosovo's rich heritage and dynamic cityscapes are now available for anyone to explore with Google Street View.

items.title: Esri's approach to responsible AI
items.summary: Organizations are making real progress with AI. Workflows are faster. Repetitive tasks that once absorbed days of analyst time now get done in minutes.

items.title: Action Required: ArcGIS Online and Location Platform SAML Customers
items.summary: ArcGIS Online (and Location Platform) Organization administrators that have enabled Signed and/or Encrypted SAML Assertions in alignment with ArcGIS Online Best Practices for SAML Security must obtain the latest ArcGIS Online Service Provider metadata file + certificate and associate it with their Enterprise (SAML) Identity Provider (e.g. Entra ID Enterprise Applications ) before August 28, 2026 to ensure continued (SAML) login operations with ArcGIS Online.

items.title: Infrastructure Isn’t Just Built Anymore. It Thinks
Frontier AI models escaped testing safeguards as Trump weighs regulations
items.summary: Just as the smoke from OpenAI’s hack of Hugging Face was beginning to clear, another frontier artificial intelligence company revealed its systems had unintentionally hacked multiple companies.

items.title: Commission tools up for AI Act enforcement as powers kick in
EU AI Act Enters Its Main Phase
items.summary: Most of Europe’s landmark AI rulebook applies from 2 August, shifting attention from legislation to enforcement The European Union’s Artificial Intelligenc The European Union’s Artificial Intelligence Act reaches its main application date on Sunday, bringing most of the bloc’s rules for high-risk systems, transparency and accountability into effect.

items.title: European Union begins enforcement of AI Act and new transparency rules from August 2
items.summary: The European Union will begin enforcing key provisions of its Artificial Intelligence (AI) Act from August 2, 2026, introducing new transparency requirements for AI systems and stronger oversight of advanced AI models.

items.title: EU to begin enforcing AI Act from Sunday with hefty fines for rule breakers
items.summary: The European Union will take a major step in regulating artificial intelligence from Sunday, when authorities gain the power to enforce key provisions of the bloc s landmark AI Act.

items.title: EU AI Act: Next level applies as of 2 August 2026
items.summary: A date worth marking in the calendar: 2 August 2026 is a key milestone for the EU AI Act, though it is not quite the case that \"the whole Act applies now.
